name: 4im-flux-studio
description: 4IM/Flux Studio — a real-time GPU fluid playground, packaged as a reusable solver, a preset CLI and a browser studio.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @4im/fluid && npm run build -w @4im/studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @4im/fluid && npm run typecheck -w @4im/studio
scripts.verify: npm run build:fluid && npm run typecheck && npm test
